miamiNews.title: Brexton Busch burnout caps emotional celebration of life for Kyle Busch at Charlotte
miamiNews.description: Brexton Busch did a burnout in his father's race car to cap off an emotional ceremony as NASCAR legend Kyle Busch was remembered in Charlotte.

tip.title: The 10-Minute Audit Rule
tip.content: Before starting your day, spend 10 minutes reviewing your highest-value tasks. Check how many PMC emails were opened/replied to overnight. This 10 minutes saves 2 hours of scattered work.
